buffer_after_minutes.description: Free time kept after a visit, in minutes.

buffer_before_minutes.description: Free time kept before a visit, in minutes.

duration_minutes.description: How long one visit takes, in minutes.

location_ids.description: Where it is offered (place ids); replaces the list.

minimum_notice_minutes.description: How long before its start a visit can still be booked, in minutes.

name.description: The service's name as customers see it, up to 160 characters.

public_staff_choice.description: Whether a customer picks the person; picking a person fits a one-person service.

resource_ids.description: Resources a visit takes one of; replaces the list.

staff_count.description: How many people one visit needs.

staff_ids.description: Who does it (ids from booking.setup.read); replaces the list.

commands.model_description: Creates a service the company offers: name, duration, buffers, notice, how many people it needs, who does it and where. The service is always created switched off, so customers cannot book it yet; tell the person to switch it on in the panel. Pass null for anything left at its default; name and duration are required. Use booking.setup.read first for the ids of people, places and resources.
commands.no_version_reason: A new service has no version yet.

summary.en: A new service, switched off until you switch it on.
summary.pl: Nowa usługa, wyłączona do czasu, aż ją włączysz.

commands.undo: none:a service is never deleted; it stays switched off

buffer_after_minutes.description: Free time kept after a visit, in minutes.

buffer_before_minutes.description: Free time kept before a visit, in minutes.

duration_minutes.description: How long one visit takes, in minutes.

location_ids.description: Where it is offered (place ids); replaces the list.

minimum_notice_minutes.description: How long before its start a visit can still be booked, in minutes.

name.description: The service's name as customers see it, up to 160 characters.

public_staff_choice.description: Whether a customer picks the person; picking a person fits a one-person service.

resource_ids.description: Resources a visit takes one of; replaces the list.

staff_count.description: How many people one visit needs.

staff_ids.description: Who does it (ids from booking.setup.read); replaces the list.

commands.model_description: Changes a service by its service_id: name, duration, buffers, notice, how many people it needs, who does it and where. Pass null for every field that stays as it is; a list given replaces the list. It cannot switch a service on or off. Use booking.setup.read first for the ids.

summary.en: A service's name, duration, buffers, people and places.
summary.pl: Nazwa, czas, przerwy, osoby i miejsca usługi.

commands.model_description: Returns the company's settings 'Online booking' (paused, resume_on): the value that applies to each, where it comes from (code, platform or the company) and the version. Use it before proposing a change. Whether customers book through the form on the company's site. A pause does not affect visits added in the panel or changes to existing bookings.
commands.no_preview_reason: A read changes nothing, so there is nothing to show first.

summary.en: Whether customers book through the form on the company's site. A pause does not affect visits added in the panel or changes to existing bookings.
summary.pl: Czy klienci rezerwują przez formularz na stronie firmy. Wstrzymanie nie dotyczy wizyt dodawanych w panelu ani zmian istniejących rezerwacji.

paused.description: Paused: the booking form on the company's site says online booking is paused and refuses new bookings; the team still adds visits in the panel and customers can still change or cancel theirs. Null keeps it as it is.

reset.description: Fields to give back to the default (the platform's or the code's); null or an empty list resets nothing.

resume_on.description: The day online booking resumes by itself, in the company's time zone (YYYY-MM-DD). Empty: paused until switched off. Null keeps it as it is.

commands.model_description: Changes the company's settings 'Online booking'. Pass null for every field that should stay as it is; list in `reset` the fields to give back to the default (the platform's or the code's). Whether customers book through the form on the company's site. A pause does not affect visits added in the panel or changes to existing bookings.

summary.en: Whether customers book through the form on the company's site. A pause does not affect visits added in the panel or changes to existing bookings.
summary.pl: Czy klienci rezerwują przez formularz na stronie firmy. Wstrzymanie nie dotyczy wizyt dodawanych w panelu ani zmian istniejących rezerwacji.

commands.model_description: Returns the company's settings 'Visit reminders' (enabled, lead_hours, min_notice_hours): the value that applies to each, where it comes from (code, platform or the company) and the version. Use it before proposing a change. Whether and when the customer gets a reminder e-mail before a confirmed visit.
commands.no_preview_reason: A read changes nothing, so there is nothing to show first.

summary.en: Whether and when the customer gets a reminder e-mail before a confirmed visit.
summary.pl: Czy i kiedy klient dostaje e-mail z przypomnieniem przed potwierdzoną wizytą.

enabled.description: Whether customers get a reminder e-mail before a confirmed visit. Off: no reminder is sent and the planned ones are dropped. Null keeps it as it is.

lead_hours.description: How many hours before the visit the reminder goes out, 1 to 168. A change re-plans the reminders not sent yet; a visit closer than that gets its reminder at once. Null keeps it as it is.

min_notice_hours.description: A visit less than this many hours away when its reminder is planned gets none (a booking for this afternoon needs no reminder). 0 keeps today's behaviour: the reminder goes out at once. Null keeps it as it is.

reset.description: Fields to give back to the default (the platform's or the code's); null or an empty list resets nothing.

commands.model_description: Changes the company's settings 'Visit reminders'. Pass null for every field that should stay as it is; list in `reset` the fields to give back to the default (the platform's or the code's). Whether and when the customer gets a reminder e-mail before a confirmed visit.

summary.en: Whether and when the customer gets a reminder e-mail before a confirmed visit.
summary.pl: Czy i kiedy klient dostaje e-mail z przypomnieniem przed potwierdzoną wizytą.

commands.model_description: Returns every service (with who does it, where and with which resource), place, resource and current person of the company, switched-off ones included, each with its id and version. Use it before creating or changing a service or someone's working hours, to know the ids. It does not return bookings.
commands.no_preview_reason: A read changes nothing, so there is nothing to show first.

summary.en: Services, places, resources and people, with the versions changes name.
summary.pl: Usługi, miejsca, zasoby i osoby, z wersjami do zmian.

rules.description: The whole week; an empty list clears it.

staff_id.description: The person whose week this is.

commands.model_description: Replaces one person's whole working week: a list of rules, each a weekday (0 is Monday), a start and an end in the company's local time as HH:MM, and the place (location_id) they work at. An empty list clears the week. Use booking.setup.read first for staff and place ids.

summary.en: One person's whole working week, rule by rule.
summary.pl: Cały tydzień pracy jednej osoby, reguła po regule.

commands.model_description: Returns the company's content languages in order (the first is its customers' language), their version, the languages this product offers, how many languages beyond the first the plan allows (null: no limit), whether adding is allowed now, and the languages that cannot be removed (a site's source language). Use it before proposing a change of languages. It does not translate anything.
commands.no_preview_reason: A read changes nothing, so there is nothing to show first.

summary.en: The languages the company speaks to customers in, and what can be added.
summary.pl: Języki, w których firma mówi do klientów, i co można dodać.

public_locales.description: The company's languages after the change, in order; the first is its customers' language.

commands.model_description: Replaces the company's content languages with the given ordered list; the first becomes its customers' language. Read them first with organization.public_locales.read@1 and pass the whole new list. Adding a language only enables it — nothing is translated and no credits are spent; the plan may limit how many languages are added. Removing a language takes its pages off the site at once and needs the person's confirmation; a site's source language cannot be removed. Do not use it for the panel's language (organization.update@1).

summary.en: Adds, removes or reorders the languages the company speaks to customers in.
summary.pl: Dodaje, usuwa albo porządkuje języki, w których firma mówi do klientów.

commands.model_description: Returns the company's basic settings: name, slug, panel language (pl or en), IANA time zone, ISO 4217 currency and the settings version. Use it before proposing a change to them. It does not return the site's public languages, the company profile or billing.
commands.no_preview_reason: A read changes nothing, so there is nothing to show first.

summary.en: The company's name, panel language, time zone and currency.
summary.pl: Nazwa, język panelu, strefa czasowa i waluta firmy.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code such as PLN or EUR; null keeps it.

default_locale.description: Language of the panel and of e-mails to the team; null keeps it.

name.description: The company's new name, up to 160 characters; null keeps it.

timezone.description: IANA time zone such as Europe/Warsaw; null keeps it.

commands.model_description: Changes the company's name, panel language, time zone or currency. Pass null for every field that should stay as it is; at least one field must change. Use it when the person asks for one of these changes. Do not use it for the site's public languages, the public company profile or billing.

summary.en: The company's name, panel language, time zone or currency.
summary.pl: Nazwa, język panelu, strefa czasowa albo waluta firmy.

commands.model_description: Puts the company's card in the public company directory, under its town and category; a card already there is refreshed. The card needs a name, a town and a category first.
commands.no_version_reason: Publication puts the card as it is; it changes none of its fields.

summary.en: The card becomes visible in the public company directory.
summary.pl: Wizytówka staje się widoczna w publicznym katalogu firm.

title.en: Put the card in the directory

commands.model_description: Takes the company's card out of the public company directory. The card itself stays and can be published again. Does nothing when the card is not listed.
commands.no_version_reason: Withdrawal removes the listing; it changes none of the card's fields.

summary.en: The card leaves the public company directory; the card itself stays.
summary.pl: Wizytówka znika z publicznego katalogu firm; sama zostaje.

title.en: Take the card out of the directory

commands.model_description: Returns the company's public business card (name, one-line headline, description, contact details, town, kind of business), whether it exists yet, whether it is in the public company directory, its version, and the towns and categories the directory accepts. Use it before changing or publishing the card.
commands.no_preview_reason: A read changes nothing, so there is nothing to show first.

summary.en: The company card, whether it is in the directory, and allowed towns and kinds.
summary.pl: Wizytówka firmy, czy jest w katalogu, oraz dozwolone miasta i kategorie.

bio.description: A description of the company, up to 4000 characters; empty clears it.

category.description: The kind of business, as a catalogue category from profiles.organization.read.

city_slug.description: The town, as a catalogue city slug from profiles.organization.read.

contact_address.description: A public address, up to 240 characters; empty clears it.

contact_email.description: A public contact e-mail; empty clears it.

contact_phone.description: A public contact phone number; empty clears it.

display_name.description: The company's name on its card, up to 160 characters.

headline.description: One sentence about the company, up to 200 characters; empty clears it.

commands.model_description: Changes the company's business card: name, one-line headline, description, contact e-mail, phone and address, town and category. Pass null for every field that stays as it is and an empty string to clear one; at least one field must change. A company without a card gets one. If the card is in the public directory the change is public at once and needs its own confirmation.

summary.en: Name, description, contact, town and kind on the card.
summary.pl: Nazwa, opis, kontakt, miasto i kategoria na wizytówce.

forms.description: Inflected forms in the source language, at most 10.

source_locale.description: The language the term is written in.

target_locale.description: Only for this language; null for every one.

term.description: The term as written in the source.

term_id.description: The term to change or remove; null to add.

commands.model_description: Adds, changes or removes one glossary term. rule: keep (unchanged everywhere, e.g. a brand), name (a person's name, transliterated into Cyrillic) or translate_as (with translation). A term is one line of at most 120 characters, with up to 10 inflected forms in the source language. For change and remove pass term_id; pass null for fields that stay.

summary.en: Add, change or remove a term a translation keeps or renders the company's way.
summary.pl: Dodaj, zmień albo usuń termin, który tłumaczenie zachowuje lub tłumaczy po swojemu.

commands.model_description: Stops a running translation job by job_id: items not started are cancelled, items in flight finish, delivered text is billed and the rest of the held credits are released. A stopped job cannot be resumed; order the rest again.

summary.en: Items not started are cancelled; only what was delivered is billed.
summary.pl: Pozycje jeszcze nierozpoczęte są anulowane, rozliczone tylko dostarczone.

commands.undo: none:a stopped job cannot be resumed; order the rest again

include_unverified.description: Also propose over texts written before provenance existed; default false.

protected.description: Texts a person or an integration wrote: skip, propose changes that wait for a person (default), or overwrite (only when the person asked for it).

targets.description: The (object, language) pairs, e.g. a site's pages in German.

basis.description: published (default): what visitors see; working: the draft open in the editor.

locale.description: A language enabled for the company.

object_id.description: The object's id in that source.

commands.model_description: Orders the AI translation of the given (object, language) pairs for the credits the quote shows; the person's click binds that quote, and if the content changes before the click the order is refused. Results that wait for a person (legal documents, review mode, a person's own text) are billed when delivered. Quote first with translation.quote and show the person the credits.
commands.no_version_reason: The quote's digest binds the consent and the order checks it again.

summary.en: Translation of the quoted items for the credits shown.
summary.pl: Tłumaczenie wycenionych pozycji za pokazane kredyty.

commands.undo: compensation:take the job back with POST /api/v1/translation/jobs/<id>/revert/

commands.model_description: Says whether the company can order an AI translation now and why not (reasons such as model_not_selected, operation_unpriced, processing_ack_required), the publication mode in force, the automation's state and the price unit (credits per 1,000 source characters per language), and every translation setting with its allowed values. Use it before quoting.
commands.no_preview_reason: A read changes nothing, so there is nothing to show first.

summary.en: Whether translation can be ordered now, in which mode and at what price.
summary.pl: Czy można teraz tłumaczyć, w jakim trybie i za ile.

include_unverified.description: Also propose over texts written before provenance existed; default false.

protected.description: Texts a person or an integration wrote: skip, propose changes that wait for a person (default), or overwrite (only when the person asked for it).

targets.description: The (object, language) pairs, e.g. a site's pages in German.

basis.description: published (default): what visitors see; working: the draft open in the editor.

locale.description: A language enabled for the company.

object_id.description: The object's id in that source.

commands.model_description: Counts what would be translated for each (object, language) pair, what it costs in credits, which results would wait for a person and why, and returns a digest. Nothing is saved. Show the person the credits and what waits before ordering with translation.job.create.
commands.no_preview_reason: A quote saves nothing, so there is nothing to show first.
commands.no_version_reason: A quote checks no version; the order checks its digest.

summary.en: How many characters, units and credits, and what will wait for approval and why.
summary.pl: Ile znaków, jednostek i kredytów, co poczeka na akceptację i dlaczego.

commands.model_description: Publishes the chosen waiting translations (ids from translation.review.list). A person's decision: it runs only after the person's click that names these items. Items without text (qa_failed, model_refused, gate_failed) cannot be accepted.

summary.en: Publishes the chosen translations the way their source publishes.
summary.pl: Publikuje wybrane tłumaczenia tak, jak publikuje je ich źródło.

commands.undo: compensation:take the translation back by reverting its job

reason.description: Only items waiting for this reason.

commands.model_description: Lists up to 50 translation results waiting for a person, oldest first, each with its id, version, reason (legal_document, review_mode, overwrites_human, qa_flagged, locale_first_appearance…) and whether it can be accepted. Pass a reason to filter, or null. Accepting needs the person's click: translation.review.accept.
commands.no_preview_reason: A read changes nothing, so there is nothing to show first.

summary.en: What waits for a person's decision and why.
summary.pl: Co czeka na decyzję osoby i dlaczego.

commands.model_description: Discards the chosen waiting translations (ids from translation.review.list); what is public stays as it is. A discarded result was billed when delivered. A person's decision: it runs only after the person's click.

summary.en: Discards the chosen translations; what is public stays.
summary.pl: Odrzuca wybrane tłumaczenia; to, co publiczne, zostaje.

commands.undo: none:a discarded result is gone; order the translation again

auto_changes.description: Translate changes automatically; null leaves it.

auto_monthly_limit.description: Credits a month for the automation, 0 to 100000; null leaves it.

mode.description: automatic or review; null leaves it.

reset.description: Settings to take back to their default; null or [] resets none.

commands.model_description: Changes the company's translation settings: mode (automatic or review), auto_changes (translate changes of published content without a click, as the person who turns it on) and auto_monthly_limit (credits a month for that, 0 turns it off). Pass null for what stays; reset lists settings to take back to their default. Turning the automation on or raising its limit needs the person's click and a second factor.

summary.en: Publication mode, the automation of changes and its monthly limit.
summary.pl: Tryb publikacji, automat zmian i jego miesięczny limit.

job_id.description: One job; null for the latest ten.

commands.model_description: Returns the state of the company's latest ten translation jobs, or of one job by job_id: queued, running, succeeded, partial, failed or canceled, with credits held and settled per part and each (object, language) item's state. Pass null for the latest jobs.
commands.no_preview_reason: A read changes nothing, so there is nothing to show first.

summary.en: The latest jobs or one job: state, parts and items.
summary.pl: Ostatnie zlecenia albo jedno zlecenie: stan, części i pozycje.
